build_custom_getter: build a context manager that applies a custom getter to class members via patched __getattribute__
create_custom_variable_getter: create a context manager that applies a getter to tf.Variables in nested structures of module members
test_custom_variable_getter: test custom_variable_getter with tf.stop_gradient to prevent gradients from flowing through variables
refactor_custom_getter: refactor _custom_getter to apply a callable to attributes of specified classes or instances
review_patch_getattribute: review _patch_getattribute context manager that temporarily replaces __getattribute__ on a class
